_comment: REQ-LV-102 follow-up (2026-07-12 self-fix pass, issues #994/#1000): a documented, time-boxed exception to the daily Cadence Contract escalation for a loop whose miss is a FULLY diagnosed, already-in-progress-fix EXTERNAL blocker (not a code bug self-fix can act on again). cadence-deadline-check.sh checks this file BEFORE spawning a self-fix session: if today's JST date is <= 'until', it logs and skips the spawn instead of burning a fresh context-less Sonnet session re-diagnosing the same known issue every day. This does NOT touch cadence.py's row-exists truth (the loop still correctly reports missed in cadence-evidence.py / weekly reports) -- it only suppresses the redundant self-fix RESPAWN. If 'until' passes and the loop is still missing its cadence, suppression auto-expires and normal escalation resumes on its own (no separate cleanup needed) -- so a wrong ETA guess can never cause a silent permanent bypass.
